integrity: Proof uses the cited full facet classification; finite exact-rational tests corroborate but cannot establish the infinite result. Related prior inradius and star results are credited; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only canonical Euclidean signed-incidence root realization, genuine bicliques with p,q>=2; no weighted or arbitrary-affine generalization. For unbalanced part sizes the optimal center polytope has exact inequalities and affine dimension, not enumerated vertices or volume.
title: A parity classification of every Euclidean incenter of complete-bipartite symmetric edge polytopes
